Name: (CP) Seasonal Leaf Decoration
Author: GalaxyRobotMods
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/m0Lfzhm.png[/img]
This is a simple mod; it adds decorative leaves to decorate any space. They change color according to the season and are very easy to obtain through the Trash Catalog!﻿﻿

This decoration acts as a rug, meaning you can walk on it and place other objects on top of it.

I also took the time to translate the object's name into all languages. Since it's a short and simple name, I don't think the translator will make any mistakes (I hope).[/center]
